newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Kelgran, Kudu talks continuing.
newsitem.headline: Kelgran, Kudu talks continuing.

text.p: South African granite producers Kelgran Ltd and Kudu Granite Ltd said in a joint statement on Wednesday that their controlling shareholders were still in negotiations.

The companies first announced they were in talks on September 17, prompting speculation of a merger in a further consolidation of the country's granite sector following Kelgran's snapping up of Ketter Granite Holdings in July.
Kudu is 56 percent owned by Germany's Deutsche Steinindustrie and Kelgran is 57.4 percent controlled by Malaysia's Mycom SA, which bought the stake from Gencor Ltd in April.
The companies gave no further details in their statement on Wednesday.
